instruction: My brother asked me to buy something for him from amazon. But I totally forgot to place the order. He sent me the money for it on venmo. Place the necessary amazon order for my home address and add a "Thank you!" comment on their venmo payment.
notes: Flow: find the brother via phone contacts (relationship=brother), find his received Venmo transaction (its description names the product), search the product on Amazon, clear the cart so the order holds exactly one item with quantity 1, look up the home address id (after reading the supervisor's addresses) and a payment card, place the order, then comment 'Thank you!' on the brother's transaction. Entities with runtime ids share the 'entity' supertype so a single (known-id ?x) predicate can be used. supervisor-complete-task takes the task records (product, address, transaction, comment) as non-API parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal; it has no answer argument since the task asks no question. Cart changes are ignored by the evaluation, so clearing the cart is safe.
